visual_identity.core_identity: A small aggressive goblinoid fighter who relies on speed, dirty tricks, and scavenged weapons rather than heavy strength.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small wiry fighter with oversized pointed ears, bent knees, ready stance, and a weapon held close.
visual_identity.head_features: Large pointed ears, short nose, angular cheeks, sharp chin, wide toothy mouth, intense eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact thin-limbed humanoid, agile rather than muscular.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly smooth skin with restrained facial creases and scars.
signature_gear: small shield or light scavenged armor

accuracy_checks: ears are clearly oversized and pointed
weapon and light armor read clearly

reference.notes: Reference guides goblin anatomy; Black-Ink style controls line art.
